header.title: One call, one belief that flipped, and the read that caught it.
header.sub: The bet I filed on you before we talked, and what changed after. That is the before and after you asked for. Three short reads, move at your own pace. Nothing here asks you for anything.

blocks.label: Three reads, each one feeds the next

faces.title: The read of you
faces.desc: who you are, built from your public voice, honest about how much it can see

faces.title: The before and after of our call
faces.desc: the bet I filed before we spoke and what changed, plus the instrument that made the read

faces.title: The receipt of our call
faces.desc: the ex-ante bet, scored line by line against what you said

blocks.h2: The thing you asked to see.
blocks.quote: it’d be great to see your hypothesis on me before and what happened after our conversation, that’s the magic
blocks.attr: You, Jul 23. You named the deliverable yourself: the before and after. This door opens on exactly that.

blocks.h2: I filed a bet on you before we talked. The one I flagged as most likely wrong broke hardest.
blocks.intro: Before the call I wrote down a falsifiable bet, and flagged the belief I thought most likely to be wrong: that the overlap between us was thin. It is the one that broke, in the best possible direction. Here is that one.

beats.before: Maybe a Google team could use this, someday.
beats.quote: a team of 20... we build internal infrastructure for the partnerships org... we take first and third party data and stitch it into briefs for execs before they meet people
beats.after: You are the exact buyer and the builder. Confidence in a real fit went from a hedge to near-certain.

blocks.caption: Three more beliefs moved too, warmer than I bet, practitioner not skeptic, and the doc-miss you caught. The full before and after is next door, scored line by line in the receipt.

blocks.h2: How it works, and how it scales.

cards.h3: A tool that sharpens you, not a copy of you
cards.p: It does not copy you or replace your judgment; it makes you sharper at your own job, and you still drive.
The states it listens for, the checks that keep a read honest, and where the fence is. You get the whole taste and the whole value; the transform stays under the hood, and some of it is patentable.
One: your own call. Few: your twenty-person org gets the read before and after. Many: the partnerships function across Alphabet. Your judgment, made portable and compounding.

cards.h3: The one thing I would do next
cards.p: A real before and after on one call that matters to you, model-agnostic, runs on Gemini, nothing leaves Google, receipts are JSON. Then you decide. The part-two follow-up you named, on your timeline.

cards.h3: The deep cut, if you want the machine
cards.p: Optional, and only if you are the kind of builder who wants to see it run: our whole call as one trajectory, hello to goodbye, every point traced to a line we actually said. Two lines, honest that it is one call. Not the thing to read first; the thing to read if the rest made you curious how it moves.

blocks.h2: What it takes to run this on one of your calls.
blocks.intro: The whole point is that it is a tiny, non-invasive lift, and it is model-agnostic, so it can run on Gemini, on your own stack. You send three things, I send back the before and after on a call that matters to you. Nothing touches your systems.

needs.p: A text or CSV export from whatever you already use, Granola, Gong, Fathom, Zoom, or Teams. One call is enough to start.
The other person's public profile, the enriched-profile input you saw feed this read. Honest about what public signal can and cannot see.
Whatever context you already have: deal stage, who was in the room, what the relationship is. Optional; it just sharpens the read.

blocks.close: That is it. From those three, I build the before and the after, free, no integration, yours to keep, on Gemini if you want.
